# SME Ops System Builder

> 71 operational database skills for small and medium businesses. Each skill defines one business process as a real table, and emits the same field list as CSV, PostgreSQL DDL, JSON Schema and a Notion property mapping from a single source, so the four artifacts cannot drift apart.

Each page answers three questions in its first screen: what the system is, why a small team needs it, and what to type to get a working version. Every page ends with a citable summary block, an author and a last-reviewed date.

## Author

- Abhishek Adhikari: <https://abhishekadhikari.com/>

Looking for AI training for your cooperative? We offer practical, customized AI training packages designed around your team’s needs and workflows. For training packages, customization, and inquiries, please visit abhishekadhikari.com and get in touch.
